opportunities.name: GitHub candidate lead research and hiring email
opportunities.description: Look up a GitHub user, review their profile and top repository, then draft an email to hiring@example.com with subject 'Lead for <role>: <username>' and a body summarising followers, top repo (stars, language) and latest post.
steps: Open github.com and click the 'Search or jump to' box
Clear it, type <github_username> and press Enter
Click the 'Users' filter in the results sidebar
Click the matching user in the results
Write down the follower count and open the top pinned/popular repository
Write down the repo's stars and main language, and find the user's latest post
Type '<github_username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <latest_post>.' in Body

instances.values: username=karpathy, role=ML Research Engineer, top repo nanoGPT (63.8k stars, Python), 226k followers, latest post microgpt
username=gaearon, role=Staff Frontend Engineer, top repo react/react (251.1k stars, JavaScript), 94k followers
username=simonw, role=Developer Advocate, top repo llm (12.6k stars, Python), 17.3k followers (paused for a Wikipedia/notes task at 775–797)

opportunities.name: Person bio + Wayback Machine homepage snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, open an archived homepage of a related site for a given year on the Wayback Machine, and save a note with the person's key bio facts and the snapshot's headline.
steps: Open Wikipedia, click 'Search Wikipedia', clear it, type <person_name> and press Enter (close any donation banner)
Write down the birth date and main role from the article's first lines and infobox
Open web.archive.org and type <domain> into the URL search box, then press Enter
Click a captured day in the calendar (e.g. an early-January date) to open the snapshot
Read the main headline or feature text on the archived homepage
Open the Notes app, click 'New note'
Type '<person_name>: born <birth_date>, <role>. <domain> in <year>: <headline>' and press Enter
